name: foxform
description: Build, publish and read scored forms, quizzes and calculators. Answer options carry points into a score, the score decides which screen comes next and which result the person sees, and calc() expressions return a quote or an ROI figure inside the page. Published forms are served as static HTML from a CDN. 10 tools: create, update, publish and unpublish a form, list and read responses, export them, and retrieve drop-off per screen.

FOXFORM_API_KEY.title: FoxForm API key
FOXFORM_API_KEY.description: Key starting with ff_live_, generated in the FoxForm dashboard under MCP & API. Listing the available tools works without it; running any tool requires it.
